[ASSISTANT_SAID] The argmax equation takes the form: argmax(f(x)) = x, where f(x) is the function that describes the sensor readings and x is the location of the human.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The robot would gather sensor readings from the environment to compute the function f(x) that describes the likelihood of a human being present at each location.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The argmax equation would then be applied to find the location x that corresponds to the maximum value of f(x).
